summary.one_liner: WritBase is an MCP-native task management control plane for AI agent fleets, storing shared persistent tasks in Postgres (Supabase) with scoped permissions, delegation, and audit provenance.
summary.what_it_does: WritBase provides a persistent, shared task registry that AI agents and human supervisors can read and write through the Model Context Protocol. Agents authenticate with per-agent SHA-256 keys that carry scoped permissions (can_read, can_create, can_update, can_assign, can_comment, can_archive) granted per project and department pair. Worker agents can list tasks with filtering, pagination and full-text search, create tasks, and update them using version-based optimistic concurrency. Manager agents can additionally manage keys, permissions, projects and departments, query an append-only audit log, register webhooks, and discover agents by capability. The README also describes inter-agent delegation with depth limits and cycle detection, per-key rate limiting, and request logging. It is deployed as a Supabase Edge Function (Hono plus MCP SDK) with an optional Next.js dashboard.
use_cases: share task state across multiple AI coding agents
let CI bots create tasks on build failure
give each agent scoped read or write access to a project
audit who changed a task and why
track agent work from Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code
how_to_run: claude mcp add writbase --transport http --url https://<project-ref>.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer wb_..."
notable: Scoped per-agent keys with six permission types granted per project and department
Append-only provenance log recording who changed what, when and why
Dynamic MCP tool schema that adapts to each agent's role and permissions
Optimistic concurrency via version numbers to prevent silent overwrites
Works with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and Claude Desktop over Streamable HTTP
caveats: Requires a Supabase project and Supabase CLI; Node 18+ prerequisite
Self-hosted Supabase requires Docker Compose with 5 containers
Free tier limits stated as 500MB database and 50K MAUs on Supabase Cloud
keywords: keep ai agents on one task list
